provenance-counted-only-executable-claim: The run verdict counted only the executable claims
verdict-claim-code-errors: not reconciled, for claim code errors
verdict-nothing-to-reconcile: not reconciled, with nothing to reconcile
summary-excluded: {count} claim codes are written in a title, a step or a comment, where no claim reads them.
summary-deferred: Scenarios a deferral tag set aside, so none of them is an executable claim: {count}.
summary-where-filed: Evidence Observations, by where they were filed
summary-total-key: the claims reconciled, a Claim Reconciliation for each: every scenario, every phantom claim (a claim code evidence cites and no scenario carries), and the unnamed claim (the evidence no one claim can take).
summary-balanced-key: the claims whose every Quality Check Reconciliation is satisfied.
summary-out-of-balance-key: the claims with any other outcome.
summary-kind-key: the kind of quality check. No kind holds what a scenario asking for no kind of check gives, and All sums every row.
summary-evidence-obligations-key: the evidence the claims ask for, one for each kind-of-quality-check tag that applies.
summary-evidence-observations-key: the results of tests and fitness functions reported.
outcome-satisfied-key: an Evidence Obligation answered by an Evidence Observation that passed.
outcome-failing-key: an Evidence Obligation answered by an Evidence Observation that failed.
outcome-cannot-fail-key: an Evidence Obligation answered by an Evidence Observation that passed in a CI step or job that sets continue-on-error, or whose continue-on-error balance cannot read, so its red might not fail the build.
outcome-missing-key: an Evidence Obligation no Evidence Observation that ran answers.
outcome-no-claim-code-key: an Evidence Obligation of a scenario with no claim code, which no evidence can cite.
outcome-duplicate-claim-code-key: an Evidence Obligation of a scenario whose claim code another scenario shares, so no evidence can answer it.
outcome-not-asked-for-key: an Evidence Observation that ran, citing a claim that asks for no check of its kind.
outcome-cites-unknown-claim-key: an Evidence Observation that ran, citing a claim code no scenario carries.
outcome-cites-no-claim-key: an Evidence Observation citing no claim code, several, or one that several scenarios share, or a CI step the step record does not name.
outcome-never-ran-key: an Evidence Observation that was reported but never ran to a result.
outcome-no-quality-check-key: a scenario with a claim code that asks for no check and has no evidence.
summary-where-filed-column-key: the claim an Evidence Observation was filed on: a scenario, a phantom claim or the unnamed claim. Total is all of them.
summary-feature-file-key: a feature file with a claim out of balance.
summary-feature-out-of-balance-key: how many of its claims are out of balance.
step-account-job-key: a job in it. The Total row, when there is more than one job, sums them.
step-account-steps-read-key: the job's steps, each counted once in one of the columns after it.
step-account-runners-key: steps that run a test runner the run names, other than one counted as a fitness function.
step-account-reconciler-steps-key: steps that run this reconciliation or write the step record it reads.
step-account-non-checks-key: steps the run names with --not-check, other than reconciler steps.
step-account-plumbing-key: steps that only set up the job with one of GitHub's own actions: checking out, caching, moving artefacts or setting up a toolchain.
step-account-fitness-functions-key: every other step, and a runner step whose id is a claim code the step record has: each a fitness function.
claim-column-key: the claim: its claim code; its code and file when another claim shares the code; its file and title when it has no code.
kind-column-fitness-key: F when the claim asks for a fitness function, - when it does not; then how many of its fitness functions ran, - for none.
kind-column-unit-key: U when the claim asks for a unit test, - when it does not; then how many of its unit tests ran, - for none. U/2 is a unit test asked for and two that ran.
kind-column-integration-key: I when the claim asks for an integration test, - when it does not; then how many of its integration tests ran, - for none.
kind-column-e2e-key: E when the claim asks for an e2e test, - when it does not; then how many of its e2e tests ran, - for none.
kind-column-performance-key: P when the claim asks for a performance test, - when it does not; then how many of its performance tests ran, - for none.
verdict-column-key: balanced when every Quality Check Reconciliation is satisfied, out-of-balance otherwise.
items-column-key: each Quality Check Reconciliation not satisfied, as its kind and outcome, then where to look and what it said. The key to the Summary's table by kind says what each outcome means.
job-holds-no-settings: the job at {place} holds no settings, so GitHub would not run its workflow
step-names-neither-action-nor-command: the step at {place} names neither an action nor a command, so GitHub would not run its workflow
